_comment: Explicit source-to-field mapping for import_archive.py. Every sheet of every listed workbook must appear here, either mapped or ignored with a reason. Paths are relative to this repository. See archive/MAPPING.md.

league._comment: Site name (owner, 2026-10-09) and home-page facts. Facts are read from 'Label: value' lines in the vault note, with [[links]] reduced to their text.
league.name: National Bastard Association

announcements.text: Keepers are live on Yahoo. Submit your keepers before the deadline runs up.

teams._comment: Team objects are built from the team names in the records. A vault note in vault_dir whose frontmatter has team_id and name (e.g. Silmaril/Bayonne Dealers.md) adds the listed fields to that team's page.

team_successions.note: The Alaskan Huskies took over the Rockaway Rangers roster (owner, 2026-10-09).

people._comment: Owner, 2026-10-09: people's names on the site are shortened to first name plus last initial (e.g. Pat Example -> Pat E.). The vault keeps full names; the importer shortens them before publishing.

fee_type._comment: Owner, 2026-10-09: the salary cell colour shows each player's keeper fee type for the coming 2026-27 season. Labels come from the legend cells in the sheet; red has no legend cell and was confirmed by the owner as CBK. `display` maps each legend label to the wording and colour key shown on the site (owner approved 2026-10-09); the workbook is unchanged.

sheets._comment: Owner, 2026-10-09: the 2025-26 draft (every pick and the drafting team). The Salary column is NOT the draft price: the owner pre-adjusted it to the price to keep each player for 2026-27, and the cell colour shows which fee was applied (legend F2:F4). Draft prices come from Accuracy.xlsx.

Owner, 2026-10-09: players kept heading into 2025-26, with their updated price to keep them for 2026-27. The keeping team, the draft pick and the 2025-26 price they were kept at come from the matching 2025-26 draft row (picks 129-156).

sheets.label: Pre-draft

undrafted_price.basis: Rule 1.c rounds undrafted players up to $10, plus the $5 first-time keeper fee (owner's rule, 2026-10-09).

sheets._comment: Owner, 2026-10-09: active rosters heading into the 2026-27 draft (rosters frozen at the end of 2025-26). Snapshot dated the day the workbook was saved, confirmed by the owner. Each player shows his recorded 2026-27 keeper price from the 2025-26 draft sheet; undrafted players get the owner's $15 rule.

Owner, 2026-10-09: the original 2025-26 draft prices, in the same pick order as the draft sheet. The Team column is empty (header D1 only); teams come from the draft sheet. Rows attach to draft records by pick and must name the same Yahoo player.

rules_excluded.reason: Hidden by the owner (2026-10-09): the earlier rule set, superseded by Rules.md.
Replaced on the site by the rule-change suggestion form (owner, 2026-10-09). The note only linked to Pre-Format Rules.

index.unavailable: vault home page, not part of this archive

accuracy_check._comment: Report-only check of the recorded 2026-27 keeper prices (Rules 1.b and 1.c). Fees are whole dollars: 10% is rounded to the nearest dollar, with 50 cents rounding up (owner, 2026-10-09; e.g. $55 -> $5.50 -> $6). Not published. Rules are keyed by the fee colour key from fee_type.display.

suggestions._comment: Owner, 2026-10-09: members suggest rule changes for the coming season through a Google Form the owner owns; responses stay private in the owner's Google account. Paste the form's share link into form_url and rerun the import.
suggestions.title: Suggest a rule change
suggestions.intro: Have an idea for a rule change before the 2026-27 season? Send it to the commissioner. Suggestions are private and reviewed before the season.
